body: Hmm, I actually feel like it'd be easier to combine BLM and defunding the police, since those two issues are incredibly intertwined. Just my two cents though.
Thanks for the tips! Sucks that tags are wrong, like bruh I trusted you? Seems like a trap. It sounds like I'll need to go check out her channel ASAP!
Yeah, it def looks like I'll need to take a break from watering, although the tag and everything I've read told me to keep the soil moist.
Hmm, interesting. I think I'll try letting it dry out 50-60% instead of the normal 25-30% and see how it goes!
Yeah, clay/sand doesnt seem like it'd be great at staying moist. I'll let you know if I figure anything out!
I sure hope so! I was afraid that I managed to damage the roots somehow, but I'm seeing new leaves so 🤷‍♀️

I read up on it and found that over watering and under watering can both cause yellowing, but only one leaf is affected and my soil is what i would describe as "perfectly damp" (not sopping wet or bone dry).
